Question: Last summer \(100\) students attended basketball camp. Of those attending, \(52\) were boys and \(48\) were girls. Also, \(40\) students were from Jones Middle School and \(60\) were from Clay Middle School. Twenty of the girls were from Jones Middle School. How many of the boys were from Clay Middle School?
